Key indicators for degradation in turbofan engines (CMAPSS-like dataset):
- **Temperature increases**: T50 (LPT outlet), T30 (HPC outlet) rising significantly indicates degradation
- **Pressure decreases**: P30 (HPC outlet pressure) declining indicates compressor degradation
- **Speed changes**: Nc (core speed) declining, Nf relatively stable
- **Slope magnitudes**: Larger positive slopes in temperatures and larger negative slopes in pressures/speeds indicate more advanced degradation
- **Absolute levels**: Higher T50, T30 means more degradation; lower P30 means more degradation

- BPR ~ 8.42-8.45 (healthy), > 8.47 indicates degradation
- W31 ~ 38.8-39.0 (healthy)
- W32 ~ 23.3-23.4 (healthy)
